decisions.summary: The old source-fragment step treated a normal ultrapower as if a measurable-cardinal hypothesis were supplied. The repair retains it only conditionally inside the contradiction from a hypothetical free ultrafilter and explicitly adds no measurable axiom.

The old proof used ordinary generic-extension transfer to justify the hereditary-symmetric submodel. The repaired item cites and traces the general symmetric-model theorem through the corrected local HS-model theorem; generic transfer now only builds the ambient set extension.

The old proof did not license the action of a forcing automorphism on RO(P). The repair defines the induced complete Boolean automorphism U↦π``U and uses symmetry on the generating set for each Boolean membership value.

The proof consumed exact H_m action facts absent from its old F1. The item now directly cites the collapse-system definition, states that H_m fixes lower layers and permits arbitrary finite coordinate permutations above m, and spells out the compatibility argument.

The old F2 attributed coded null/meagre witnesses to definitions that only define the notions. The repair constructs the rational-cover and closed-nowhere-dense witness codes explicitly, adds the measure/countable-choice suppliers, and separates perfectness from nonemptiness.

The old proof assumed an arbitrary intermediate model and its dense families were ambient-countable. The repair restricts N and Q to bounded collapse stages and proves the N-families of dense subsets of Q and Q² have size below κ and become countable after the tail collapse.

The old F3 falsely attributed preservation of an inaccessible to the finite L-interpretation supplier. The repair proves downward preservation directly and narrows the formalization claim to externally fixed finite fragments, with separate reflected CTM and conversion proofs and no uniform arithmetic transformer.

The old F2 did not justify a well-order of unbounded ordinal tuples and fixed predicate parameters. The repair orders each code by rank, then formula/arity, then the fixed-arity tuple below that rank; A and f remain fixed predicates/parameters and are never well-ordered.

The old item used generic largeness without assuming the intermediate model had countably many reals. The repair removes that dependency and conclusion: it represents truth only on N-random or N-Cohen generics for a localized N=V[f], leaving removal of nongenerics to consumers that verify countability.

The old proof treated binary decision density as exact ordinal-name decision. The repair bounds all possible values by name rank and ordinal preservation, proves their Boolean-value join is 1, refines to a deciding antichain, and only then localizes the countable family of antichains.

The old proof asserted the false inclusion N⊂M to transfer a Borel code. The repair uses the actual same-reals theorem: both the N-coded representative and the ambiently coded null exception are reals of V[G], hence belong to M, where coded absoluteness and completeness apply.

The old proof treated “τ is not in N” as a forcing formula. The repair forms the set D of conditions forcing equality with some check real of N, uses genericity to obtain p₀ incompatible with D, and separately forces the membership formula; the resulting p has the exact name-level premise of the perfect-tree lemma.

The cited local rule-soundness proof explicitly defines W and Phi before proving scheme preservation, matching Halpern–Läuchli’s primary-source word calculus; Terra’s missing-definition objection is false.

The old theorem attributed the CTM and conversion hypotheses to a supplier that did not state them. The repaired formalization supplier now states those two externally indexed proofs, and this theorem applies the finite-fragment transfer interface only to that exact strengthened statement.

The old PSP argument obtained neither an interval-collapse name nor the perfect-tree newness premise. The repair cites the generic-extension definition for the name, uses bounded-stage factorization, and repeats the D/D⊥ argument. It also repairs the R³ transfer by deriving a Borel measure-preserving three-stream code rather than reversing a one-way supplier.

The old null-coset contradiction lacked translation invariance and monotonicity. The repair adds those exact suppliers, verifies DC⇒Countable Choice before using measure theorems, and explicitly derives the null union’s contradiction with λ([0,1])=1.

The old F2 treated the finite-definition-code supplier as a well-order of hierarchy stages and real parameters. The repair recursively unfolds a finite definition tree, orders only its bounded finite ordinal labels, interleaves finitely many real leaves into one real, and explicitly assumes A≠∅ with a₀∈A in the DC construction.
